links.comparator_used: Applying the SVM classifier to all scans without confidence-based stratification (overall performance, AUC 0.71)
links.outcome: Classification accuracy for future dementia prediction in high-confidence (distance-from-hyperplane) subgroup vs all scans
links.effect: High-confidence subgroup (~35% of scans) had accuracy of around 80%; overall model AUC 0.71
links.tradeoff: Only about 35% of scans fall in the high-confidence subgroup, so selective use of high-certainty predictions leaves the remaining ~65% without a high-confidence prediction.
links.quote: Confidence-based stratification identified a high-confidence subgroup comprising approximately 35% of scans, within which prediction accuracy increased to around 80%.
